tools.name: assemble
tools.description: Runs the Assembler. You MUST call the relevant recipe skill before loading anything. On success the tray is cleared and output goes directly to inventory — do NOT call unload after a successful run.

tools.name: forge
tools.description: Runs the Forge. You MUST call the relevant recipe skill before loading anything. On success the tray is cleared and output goes directly to inventory — do NOT call unload after a successful run.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Returns the current factory state (inventory and all device trays) as a JSON string.

tools.name: load
tools.description: Moves items from inventory into a device input tray. device must be exactly "smelter", "forge", or "assembler".

tools.name: mine_copper_ore
tools.description: Mines 1 Copper Ore and adds it to inventory.

tools.name: mine_iron_ore
tools.description: Mines 1 Iron Ore and adds it to inventory.

tools.name: skill_assemble_electric_motor
tools.description: Call this first when asked to build an Electric Motor. Returns the complete step-by-step manufacturing protocol.

tools.name: skill_recipe_copper_coil
tools.description: Recipe for assembling a Copper Plate into Copper Coils.

tools.name: skill_recipe_copper_plate
tools.description: Recipe for smelting Copper Ore into Copper Plates.

tools.name: skill_recipe_electric_motor
tools.description: Recipe for assembling an Iron Gear and Copper Coils into an Electric Motor.

tools.name: skill_recipe_iron_gear
tools.description: Recipe for forging Iron Plates into an Iron Gear.

tools.name: skill_recipe_iron_plate
tools.description: Recipe for smelting Iron Ore into Iron Plates.

tools.name: skill_salvage_iron_plate
tools.description: Protocol for recovering an Iron Plate by dismantling an Iron Gear when Iron Ore is depleted.

tools.name: smelt
tools.description: Runs the Smelter. You MUST call the relevant recipe skill before loading anything. On success the tray is cleared and output goes directly to inventory — do NOT call unload after a successful run.

tools.name: unload
tools.description: Moves items from a device input tray back to inventory. device must be exactly "smelter", "forge", or "assembler".
